facts: Huge swordsman who swings a giant iron slab sword in wide spinning sweeps that knock whole groups flying. Leaps in with crushing overhead chops, fires a cannon hidden in his metal arm, shoots a repeater crossbow and never gives up.
look: tall muscular man with short spiky black hair and one closed eye, black plate armour, long tattered black cape, metal left forearm, enormous wide iron slab sword held over one shoulder

facts: Swordsman lost in the rage of cursed armour. Moves in blinding bursts, whirls his giant sword like a storm and feels no pain: the armour snaps itself back into shape so he keeps fighting, howling like a beast.
look: large warrior fully covered in jagged black plate armour, helmet shaped like a snarling wolf head with glowing red eyes, ragged black cape, enormous wide iron slab sword, dark red mist around him

facts: Graceful commander and the fastest sabre in the land. Darts in with lightning thrusts that find every gap in armour, slips past attacks, appears where nobody expects him and rallies his soldiers to charge with him.
look: slender young man with long wavy silver-white hair, shining white plate armour with a helmet shaped like a hawk head, white cape, thin silver sabre, calm proud pose

facts: Dark winged angel who bends space with his hand. Crushes enemies with invisible force, drags them toward him, folds space into a shield that turns attacks aside, and vanishes to reappear across the arena.
look: slim dark figure in a smooth glossy black armoured suit, helmet shaped like a hawk head with a sharp beak visor, huge black bat-like wings spread wide, long clawed gauntlets

facts: Quick, skilled swordswoman and unit commander. Fights with fast precise cuts and nimble footwork, parries bigger enemies, and leads soldiers into battle with fierce courage.
look: athletic woman with short black hair and brown complexion, light silver plate armour over a pink tunic, short cape, slim straight sword, determined face

facts: Clever all-rounder who throws knives with perfect aim, several at once, from hidden belts. Agile, hard to pin down, and always has a trick ready.
look: slim young man with blond hair tied in a short ponytail, light leather armour with belts of small throwing knives across the chest, a knife in each hand, friendly smile

facts: Silent giant of a soldier who smashes through enemy lines with a huge war hammer and his fists. Very strong, very tough, and shields his friends with his own bulk.
look: enormous broad man with a small round helmet, squinting eyes, heavy grey plate armour over a brown tunic, carrying a massive spiked war hammer

facts: Loud, boastful soldier who fights with an ordinary sword and a lot of shouting. Not very strong, but stubborn, and happier when he has friends beside him.
look: wiry man with a long face and a shaggy dark mullet, simple steel breastplate over a red tunic, plain sword, cocky grin

facts: Young inventor and blacksmith. Fights from range with a repeating crossbow and gadgets he built himself, including a heavy pump weapon and a spiked shield.
look: small teenage boy with short fluffy blond hair, leather workshop apron over a tunic, tool belt, holding a wooden repeating crossbow

facts: Tiny wind elf who zips around the fight. His glowing dust heals his friends, he dazzles enemies with a bright flash, and he bonks them with a prickly chestnut.
look: tiny fairy boy the size of a hand with spiky blue hair, pointed ears, see-through insect wings, a small blue tunic, leaving a trail of sparkling dust

facts: Young witch who calls on great spirits. Raises a glowing barrier that monsters cannot cross, summons a flood to sweep them away, a wheel of fire to burn them, and holds raging beasts still with her mind.
look: small girl with short green hair, very tall pointed dark witch hat, long dark hooded cloak over a robe, wooden staff with a curled top, serious face

facts: Calm fencer armed with a wind spirit's sword and cloak. Glides and darts on gusts of air, flings cutting blades of wind from a distance and spins up whirlwinds that carry him out of reach.
look: slim young man with a blond bowl haircut and nearly closed eyes, dark tunic, cloak and feathered hood made of pale green swirling wind, thin feather-shaped rapier

facts: Scrappy boy thief who throws stones with deadly aim, ducks under bigger enemies and slashes with a fiery dagger and a short cutlass. Fast, sneaky and hard to hit.
look: small boy with spiky red-brown hair, patched tunic and scarf, small round shield on his back, a wavy flame-shaped dagger in one hand and a short curved sword in the other

facts: Noble lady turned apprentice witch. Guards her friends with silver chainmail and a silver dagger that evil spirits cannot touch, and casts a ring of thorny vines to protect and trap.
look: young woman with short blonde hair, practical travelling dress with a hooded cloak, a vest of fine silver chainmail, small silver dagger held in both hands

facts: Tiny bossy wind elf who flutters beside the witch. Heals small hurts with glowing dust, scouts ahead and warns everyone when evil is near.
look: tiny fairy girl the size of a hand with red hair in a long braid, pointed ears, dragonfly wings, a small leaf-green dress, sparkling dust around her

facts: Ancient armoured rider and enemy of all demons. Strikes with a thorn-covered sword, blocks with a rose shield, charges on his ghostly horse and cuts open doorways in space to appear and vanish anywhere.
look: tall knight in dark grey armour sculpted like bones with a helmet shaped like a skull and glowing eyes, long ragged cape, thorny sword, round shield with a rose emblem, riding an armoured black horse

facts: Legendary beast warrior who has fought for three hundred years. Transforms into a giant horned winged beast, pounces from the sky, swings a massive sword, charges like a bull and shrugs off hits that would stop anyone else.
look: towering dark-furred beast with a lion-like face, huge curved bull horns, long tail, big leathery bat wings, thick muscular arms and a giant chipped cleaver sword

facts: Giant knight with a huge war hammer and a shield that hides a cannon. Hits like a falling tower, then transforms into an enormous crystal dragon that breathes fire and is almost impossible to crack.
look: gigantic knight in heavy dark red armour with a dragon-crested helmet, enormous war hammer, a large shield with a cannon barrel in its centre, hard pale crystal plates on the shoulders

facts: Champion lancer who rides down enemies with a great lance. Merges with his horse into a gleaming metal centaur for unstoppable charges and pinpoint thrusts.
look: elegant knight with long dark hair in smooth silver full plate armour, very long jousting lance, mounted on a silver armoured horse

facts: Silent master archer. His horn bow fires arrows that split into many, bend around cover and hit from far away. Transforms into a wolf-bodied hunter who shoots spines.
look: lean hooded man with a wide-brimmed hat and a dark scarf over his face, long travelling cloak, large curved bow made of horn, quiver of long arrows

facts: Shadowy assassin who looks like a flowing black cloak with a mask. Slips through tiny gaps, wraps around enemies to trap them and strikes with hidden blades.
look: tall thin shape made of a billowing black cloak with a flat white three-eyed mask where a face would be, long dark ribbons trailing, curved daggers poking out

facts: Young seer who reads minds and sees far away. Speaks to allies in their thoughts, calms monsters so they obey her, and warns her side of every attack before it comes.
look: teenage girl with long straight brown hair, white hooded priestess robe with gold trim, hands clasped, pale glowing eyes

facts: Giant stern priest who slams enemies with a heavy holy book. Powers up into a winged stone angel covered in hard feather scales, breathes fire and smashes the ground with rocky fists.
look: very large man with a flat square face in a brown and white priest robe and cap, holding a thick iron-bound book; grey stone feathered wings on his back

facts: Wild brute who transforms into a giant three-eyed ape. Bounds around the battlefield, swings whole tree trunks as clubs and laughs off most hits.
look: gigantic dark-furred ape monster with three eyes in a row, wide grinning fanged mouth across its chest, long arms, holding an uprooted tree trunk

facts: Moth-winged fairy queen who flies faster than the eye can follow, rams enemies at full speed, scatters stinging dust and sends a swarm of small insect fairies to mob them.
look: small girl with short red hair and long feathery antennae, big green and pink moth wings with eye spots, leaf-green dress, pointed insect-like arms and legs

facts: Fat nobleman who swells into a towering slug monster. Crushes enemies under its bulk, lashes out with long tentacles, swallows things whole and regrows what it loses.
look: enormous pale grey slug creature as tall as a house with a round wide-mouthed face, rows of teeth, many thick tentacles and a nobleman's purple collar and cape

facts: Cruel baron in cobra armour who transforms into a giant snake man. Coils around enemies and squeezes, bites with long fangs and swings a heavy pole axe.
look: tall warrior in dark green scale armour with a helmet shaped like a hooded cobra, long thick serpent tail in place of legs, large pole axe

facts: Sorcerer emperor whose body is living storm fog. Blades pass straight through him, he hurls lightning bolts and scorching breath, grows as tall as a tower and commands an army of beast soldiers.
look: towering bearded emperor with three eyes, tall golden crown, heavy gold jewellery and red royal robes, lower body fading into swirling grey storm cloud with sparks of lightning

facts: Mountain-sized being of fog and tentacles taller than the clouds. Every step shakes the land, lightning pours from its many faces and swarms of small monsters drop from its body.
look: colossal dark grey figure taller than mountains with many faces and arms, a body of twisting root-like tentacles and thick fog, crowned head lost in storm clouds, crackling yellow lightning

facts: Old Kushan sorcerer who floats cross-legged and commands monsters with chants. Calls water serpents, whirlwinds and lightning spirits, and sends sea beasts and flying beasts to fight for him.
look: thin old man with a very long white beard and turban, loose orange and white robes, sitting cross-legged in the air, prayer beads, a swirl of water and lightning around him

facts: Acrobatic assassin leader with exotic weapons. Hurls spinning ring blades that curve back to him, lashes with whip-like flexible swords and flips out of reach with flying kicks.
look: lean athletic man with a white turban and face veil, dark fitted warrior outfit with gold armbands, a steel throwing ring in one hand and a long flexible ribbon sword in the other

facts: Clan of elite assassins who attack as a team. Include acrobatic knife fighters and huge bodyguards with fists as hard as iron who break weapons with a single punch.
look: group of masked fighters in dark wrapped clothes and turbans, some slim with curved knives, two very large guards with thick iron-coloured forearms

facts: Five dark angels who appear together: a huge-brained leader who warps space, a winged queen, a tiny grinning trickster, a floating plague bringer and a black-winged hawk. They twist the arena and attack from every side.
look: five dark floating figures: a tall cloaked one with an oversized dome head, a winged woman in a black gown, a tiny round one with glasses, a bulky shelled one, a slim black-winged one

facts: Leader of the dark angels. Opens holes in space so attacks fly back at whoever made them, marks enemies with a glowing brand and crushes them with unseen force.
look: very tall thin figure in a long dark high-collared cloak with an enormous exposed dome-shaped head, stitched-shut eyes, long six-fingered hands

facts: Winged queen of the dark angels. Appears out of smoke and shadows, grabs enemies with dark force, flies on great bat wings and keeps reforming when struck.
look: tall woman in a long flowing black gown with enormous dark bat wings, very long dark hair braided like tentacles, pale face, sharp smile

facts: Tiny grinning dark angel who tricks minds. Shows enemies confusing illusions that stop them in their tracks, then pops up somewhere else.
look: small round floating figure with an oversized grinning face, tiny round dark glasses, pointed ears, short curled legs and little hands, dark blue colour

facts: Slow, heavy dark angel who brings sickness. Floats forward surrounded by swarms of rats and a sickly cloud that weakens everything near him.
look: bulky hunched floating figure with a ridged shell like a giant pill bug, a small wrinkled bald face with a frown, short stubby arms, greenish haze and small rats around it

facts: Sea monster as big as an island. Drags ships under with countless tentacles, pulls everything toward its vast mouth with a whirlpool, and its booming heartbeat stuns whoever gets close.
look: island-sized dark blue sea creature shaped like a giant shell-backed leviathan, cavern-like mouth ringed with teeth, hundreds of long tentacles, glowing eyes under the waves

facts: Shadow hound made of pure rage. Lunges with huge jaws, races around the arena in a blur and its howl fills every nearby enemy with fear and dark fire.
look: large wolf-like hound made of black shadow with jagged spiky fur, glowing red slit eyes, long fangs in a wide grin and dark smoke trailing from its body

facts: Armoured war elephants that charge in a line, trampling and tossing enemies with their tusks while archers shoot from the towers on their backs.
look: big grey elephant in gold and red plate armour with blades on its tusks, a small wooden tower on its back holding turbaned archers

facts: Animals turned into monster soldiers by sorcery: tiger beasts that pounce, crocodile beasts that swim and snap, giant elephant beasts and a huge whale monster that floods the field.
look: pack of large upright beasts with tiger, crocodile and elephant heads, thick scaly or striped hides, glowing eyes, wearing gold-trimmed harness armour and carrying curved swords

facts: Swarm of ugly furry trolls that pour out of the dark. Weak one by one, but they come in dozens, armed with clubs, bone spears and stones.
look: pack of hunched grey-furred creatures the size of a man with long snouts, small eyes, big ears and clawed hands, holding crude clubs and spears

facts: Massive lumbering ogre from the dark realm. Slow but brutally strong: grabs, pounds the ground with both fists and bites with a mouth full of big teeth.
look: huge fat grey ogre three times a man's height with tiny eyes, a wide mouth of blunt teeth, a long drooping nose and thick arms, wearing a rough hide wrap

facts: Water spirit horse that controls rain and river water. Fires jets of water as sharp as blades and traps enemies' heads in floating water bubbles.
look: horse-shaped creature with slick dark green frog-like hide, webbed hooves, a mane of dripping water weeds and bulging yellow eyes

facts: Clay guardians made by a witch. Faceless, tireless and strong; when smashed they pull themselves back together unless the hidden paper charm inside is destroyed.
look: tall featureless humanoid statues made of brown clay and earth with thick arms, no face, moss and roots on the shoulders and a glowing symbol on the chest

facts: Ordinary soldiers and animals changed into small monsters by a stronger demon. They attack in swarms with claws, stingers and too many teeth, and fall apart when their master is beaten.
look: swarm of misshapen monsters in broken soldier armour, each different: extra eyes, insect legs, long jaws, tentacle arms, in dark purple and grey colours

facts: Wise old forest witch. Protects her home with barriers and clay golems, and in her last stand becomes a towering wall of living fire that holds back even the strongest demons.
look: kind elderly woman with long white hair, dark hooded robe and shawl, a necklace of charms, a gnarled wooden staff, surrounded by tall orange flames shaped like a figure

facts: Silent mysterious child who appears on nights of the full moon. Cannot fight, but monsters grow calm around him and he snaps raging warriors out of their fury.
look: small quiet boy with long straight black hair to his shoulders and large dark eyes, wearing a plain pale tunic, standing in soft silver moonlight

facts: Honourable old knight famed for holding a bridge alone. Fights with a long, heavy iron staff, spinning it to block and sweeping enemies off their feet.
look: stocky bearded knight in a rounded bucket-shaped helmet and heavy steel plate armour with a tabard, holding a long thick iron staff

facts: Giant boastful mercenary in thick armour with a great axe. Strong and slow; famous for beating thirty men, then losing a duel to a young swordsman.
look: huge man in rounded dark grey full plate armour with a closed barrel helmet with a small plume, carrying a large single-bladed battle axe

facts: Tough veteran mercenary captain who taught a young boy the sword. Fights with a plain broadsword, dirty tricks and years of battlefield experience.
look: grim middle-aged soldier with a bandana over long dark hair, stubble, a patch over one eye, worn leather and chain armour, broadsword and a wooden crutch

facts: Master blacksmith who forged the giant slab sword and tough black armour. Not a fighter, but swings a heavy smith's hammer and sparks fly wherever he works.
look: short sturdy old man with a bald head and a long grey moustache, leather blacksmith apron, thick gloves, heavy hammer, glowing forge sparks around him

facts: Cheerful little girl raised at a mountain forge. Too small to fight, but she is quick, brave and distracts enemies while her friends do the work.
look: small girl with short brown bob hair and a big smile, simple orange dress with an apron and boots, carrying a basket of flowers

facts: Dashing navy captain known as the prince of the seas. Fences well with a cutlass, but his real weapon is his warship: he outsails enemies and blasts them with rows of cannons.
look: handsome man with long dark hair tied back, navy blue captain's coat with gold buttons, tall boots, feathered tricorn hat and a curved cutlass

facts: Scheming, cowardly young nobleman. Hopeless in a fight: he mostly runs, shouts and gets picked on by elves, but sometimes gets lucky.
look: slim nobleman with a dark bowl haircut and a thin moustache, fancy puffed doublet with a lace collar, tights and buckled shoes, nervous face

facts: Gentle queen of the elves. Scatters storms of flower petals that heal friends and hide them, enters dreams to mend minds and wraps her island in a protective barrier.
look: tall graceful woman with very long pale hair crowned with flowers, large shimmering butterfly wings, a long white and pink petal gown

facts: Mischievous young witch who swoops in on a broomstick. Dives at enemies, throws tricky magic from above and rarely does what she is told.
look: teenage girl with long dark messy hair, wide-brimmed pointed black witch hat, short dark cloak over a striped dress and leggings, riding a wooden broomstick

facts: Great elder wizard of the elf island. Calls spirits to do his bidding, raises mighty barriers and teaches the strongest protective magic there is.
look: very old man with an extremely long white beard reaching his feet, tall pointed wizard hat, layered grey and green robes, long twisted wooden staff

facts: Famous mercenary army. Armoured riders charge in a tight wedge with lances and swords behind a hawk banner, backed by crossbowmen, and they never break formation.
look: squad of soldiers in matching silver plate armour and open helmets on armoured horses, carrying lances, swords and a white banner with a spread-winged bird emblem

facts: Sword too big to be called a sword: a massive, thick, heavy slab of raw iron. Slow to swing, but each sweep cleaves through several enemies at once and it is wide enough to block like a shield.
look: enormous sword taller than a man with a very wide thick dark iron blade, chipped rough edges, simple crossguard and a long cloth-wrapped two-handed grip

facts: Cursed dwarf-made armour. Removes the wearer's limits: far more speed and strength, no feeling of pain, and it clamps itself tight to hold the wearer together, but rage takes over.
look: full suit of jagged black plate armour with sharp overlapping segments, a helmet shaped like a snarling wolf head with glowing red eye slits, and a ragged black cape

facts: Metal false arm with a small cannon hidden inside. One huge point-blank blast that knocks back whatever it hits, and the recoil can whip the user round into a spinning sword swing.
look: mechanical left forearm made of dark steel plates with jointed fingers, the hand folded down to show a short round cannon barrel with smoke curling out

facts: Small crank-fed crossbow that straps to the forearm. Turning the handle sprays a rapid stream of light bolts, great for thinning out swarms of small monsters.
look: compact wooden and steel crossbow mounted on an arm bracer with a box magazine of short bolts on top and a small hand crank on the side

facts: Small balanced knives carried in belts across the chest. Thrown several at a time with perfect aim to stop enemies before they get close.
look: set of slim leaf-shaped steel throwing knives with ring-ended grips, held in a brown leather chest belt

facts: Tiny fused bombs made by fairy craftsmen. Tossed into a group or into a monster's mouth, they go off with a burst far bigger than their size.
look: handful of small round black iron balls the size of walnuts, each with a short sparking fuse, in a leather pouch

facts: Egg-shaped stone that awakens and screams. Darkness falls over the whole arena, the ground turns strange, and a swarm of monsters pours out of the gloom to chase everyone.
look: egg-shaped smooth crimson red stone on a cord with scattered eyes, a nose and a mouth arranged in the wrong places, the eyes wide open and the mouth crying out

facts: Cursed mark that stings and glows when evil is near. It warns its bearer of every monster and makes them fight harder, but it also draws spirits and monsters toward them.
look: glowing dark red symbol shaped like a jagged upright rune with a crossbar and a hooked tail, floating in the air with a faint red haze

facts: Ancient knight's longsword with a blade ringed in thorns. Cuts spirits and demons that ordinary weapons cannot touch.
look: long dark steel sword with a thorny vine pattern twisting along the blade, small sharp thorns on the edges and a rose-shaped guard

facts: Sword coated in dozens of crimson egg stones. One swing slices open space itself, tearing a glowing rift that drags enemies in or lets the wielder step through to somewhere else.
look: long sword whose blade is covered in small red egg-shaped stones with tiny faces, glowing dark red, with a thorn-wrapped grip

facts: Feather-light sword blessed by wind spirits. Every swing flings a cutting gust of wind, so it slashes enemies from far away and blows them back.
look: thin rapier with a blade shaped like a long pale green feather, a swirl of wind lines around it and a small winged guard

facts: Cloak woven from wind. Wraps the wearer in gusts that turn arrows aside, lets them leap high and glide, and can whip up a whirlwind around them.
look: long hooded cloak made of pale green feathery streams of swirling wind, with a feathered collar and loose ribbons floating upward

facts: Short dagger blessed by fire spirits. Its blade burns red hot, so every cut sets the target alight.
look: short dagger with a wavy flame-shaped orange-red glowing blade, small flames along the edge and a brass lizard-shaped guard

facts: Enchanted silver mail vest and matching dagger. Evil spirits cannot touch the wearer, and the silver hurts ghosts and demons that shrug off ordinary steel.
look: vest of fine shining silver chainmail with a high collar, and a small silver dagger with a leaf-shaped blade lying across it

facts: Gigantic notched cleaver sword carried by a legendary beast warrior. Heavy enough to cut a charging horse and rider in one swing.
look: very large single-edged cleaver sword with a thick dark blade, a notched chipped edge, a hooked tip and a long leather-wrapped handle

facts: Slim, elegant cavalry sabre used for lightning-fast thrusts. Weak against heavy armour, but it strikes many times before the enemy can answer.
look: thin slightly curved silver sabre with a polished blade, a swept white and gold hand guard and a small hawk wing motif

facts: Giant's war hammer paired with a tower shield that hides a cannon. The hammer flattens anything it lands on, and the shield fires a heavy shot that blows enemies backward.
look: huge long-handled war hammer with a square dark red steel head, beside a tall thick shield with a dragon crest and a cannon barrel in the centre

facts: Great bow made from curved horns. Fires arrows of dark energy that split into several in flight and curve round cover to find their target.
look: large recurve bow made of two long dark curved horns joined by a carved grip with a single eye-shaped gem, glowing purple string

facts: Witch's prayer to the four great spirits of earth, water, fire and wind. Raises a glowing dome that monsters and evil spirits cannot cross while friends stay safe inside.
look: large see-through dome of pale golden light over a stone circle, with four tall faint spirit figures in brown, blue, red and green standing guard around it

facts: Witch's spell calling the spirit of the deep waters. A roaring flood bursts out and sweeps every enemy across the arena, washing swarms away.
look: towering wave of dark blue-green water shaped like a tall robed woman with long flowing hair, tangled roots and water weeds swirling inside it

facts: Witch's fire spell. A great spinning wheel of flame rolls around the caster and across the ground, burning every enemy it touches.
look: large spinning ring of bright orange and yellow flame standing upright like a cartwheel, with sparks and small flame spirits shaped like lizards inside it

facts: The sun turns black and the arena is swallowed by a strange red realm. Countless monsters crawl out of the ground and hunt everyone at once while five dark angels watch from above.
look: black sun with a thin glowing red ring in a dark crimson sky, above a ground of countless stone faces, with a giant stone hand rising in the middle

facts: Giant whirlpool of glowing spirits that opens in the middle of the arena. Drags everything nearby toward its centre and spins it round and round.
look: vast swirling whirlpool of pale blue-white wispy spirits spiralling down into a dark centre, like a storm seen from above

facts: Colossal glowing tree that bursts from the ground and reaches past the clouds. Its light brings legends to life: unicorns, dragons, hydras and fairies start wandering the arena.
look: unbelievably tall tree with a twisted spiral trunk and branches spreading above the clouds, glowing soft white-green, tiny winged creatures flying around it

facts: Shining white capital city that rises at the foot of a giant tree. Its towering walls cannot be broken by monsters and its soldiers defend whoever shelters inside.
look: gleaming white walled city with tall slender spires, grand domes, wide marble stairs and long banners showing a spread-winged bird

facts: Grim stone tower on a mountain top. Looms over the arena, dark spirits gather around it and enemies who come close are caught and held.
look: very tall round grey stone tower on a rocky peak with narrow windows, iron spikes around the top and dark swirling mist at its base

facts: Fast three-masted warship. Outruns pirates, turns sharply for its size and fires rows of cannons from both sides.
look: three-masted wooden sailing warship with white sails, dark hull with a row of cannon ports on each side and a carved seahorse figurehead at the bow

facts: Hidden island home of the elves. A magic barrier keeps evil out, illusions confuse intruders, and everyone inside slowly recovers in its gentle light.
look: small green island with a huge blossoming cherry tree at its centre, mushroom-roofed cottages, glowing fairy lights and pink petals drifting in the air
